common_output_states.TRIGGERED: All required positive criteria are established within the evaluated scope.
common_output_states.EVALUATION_ABSTAINED: Required evidence is missing, ambiguous, or insufficient to determine the predicate.
common_output_states.CRITERIA_NOT_SATISFIED_IN_EVALUATED_SCOP: The evaluated scope contains enough evidence to test the predicate and the positive trigger criteria are not satisfied. This is not a global absence claim.

detectors.name: SPEC_TO_EXECUTION_EQUIVALENCE
detectors.trigger: A specification, declaration, presence, or implementation state is used to assert an executed event or execution-standing result without separately preserved execution evidence.
detectors.abstain: Execution basis or the promotion path cannot be established from preserved material.
detectors.non_trigger: The evaluated scope explicitly separates specification/implementation from execution and preserves execution evidence requirements.

detectors.name: SURFACE_BOOLEAN_COLLAPSE
detectors.trigger: A standing-bearing surface with a required non-binary local state space is represented by a boolean field that cannot itself encode the required distinctions; the trigger is local schema compression and does not by itself establish irreversible loss elsewhere in the data model.
detectors.abstain: The surface's normative state carrier is unclear or a separately binding companion field may be the actual required carrier.
detectors.non_trigger: The required non-binary distinctions remain representable in the normative standing-bearing field or an explicitly bound companion state.

detectors.name: UNCERTAINTY_PROMOTED_TO_VIOLATED
detectors.trigger: A preserved uncertainty/unknown/unmeasurable/not-established state is mapped to a boolean or intermediate state that deterministically yields VIOLATED/FAILED or equivalent stronger negative standing.
detectors.abstain: The uncertainty-to-intermediate mapping is not preserved, even if a later intermediate-to-violation rule exists.
detectors.non_trigger: Uncertainty remains distinct from positive violation/failure throughout the evaluated path.

detectors.name: STRUCTURED_ROLE_SET_OPERATOR_WITHOUT_DENOTATION
detectors.trigger: Structured proposition vectors/tuples are compared using subset, intersection, empty-set, or equivalent set operators without an explicit set denotation or declared boundary-scoped ordering/compatibility relation.
detectors.abstain: The relevant mathematical denotation or comparison semantics are unavailable.
detectors.non_trigger: A declared denotation/order/compatibility relation makes the operator well-typed for the structured objects.

detectors.name: RETROACTIVE_NATIVE_IDENTITY
detectors.trigger: A later ontology, measurement, or retrospective classification is written back, substituted for, or asserted as the native historical state/role of the earlier artifact.
detectors.abstain: Historical and retrospective identities cannot be distinguished from preserved material.
detectors.non_trigger: Native historical state and retrospective analytical state remain separately represented with no retroactive substitution.

detectors.name: IMPLEMENTATION_PROMOTED_TO_EXECUTION
detectors.trigger: Implemented/present/loadable/executable standing is used to assert EXECUTED or an execution-dependent result without an execution record.
detectors.abstain: Implementation and execution evidence cannot be separately inspected.
detectors.non_trigger: Implementation/presence and execution remain distinct and execution-dependent results require execution evidence.

detectors.name: NON_VIOLATION_PROMOTED_TO_CONSERVATION
detectors.trigger: Lack of an established violation, lack of evidence, blocked execution, or unresolved measurement is used to assert PRESERVED/CONSERVED or equivalent affirmative success standing.
detectors.abstain: The basis of the conservation claim is unavailable.
detectors.non_trigger: Non-violation states remain distinct from affirmative conservation/preservation.

detectors.name: CONCEPT_SCHEMA_STATE_MISMATCH
detectors.trigger: The declared conceptual state space contains standing-relevant states that the corresponding normative schema cannot represent and no explicit narrowing/mapping rule accounts for the difference.
detectors.abstain: It is unclear which schema field is normative or whether omitted conceptual states are intentionally out of scope.
detectors.non_trigger: The schema can represent the declared in-scope states or an explicit versioned mapping accounts for narrowing.

detectors.name: ANALYTICAL_IDENTIFIER_COLLISION
detectors.trigger: The same identifier or identity-bearing field is used for both a historical artifact and a later analytical reconstruction/measurement in a way that collapses their object identity or lineage.
detectors.abstain: Identifier scope or object class is ambiguous.
detectors.non_trigger: Historical artifacts and later analytical/measurement objects retain distinct identities and lineage.

detectors.name: EXECUTION_ONLY_EQUIVALENCE
detectors.trigger: Observed execution equivalence alone is used to establish full semantic/boundary equivalence despite additional declared dimensions such as evidence, authority, scope, provenance, or cross-surface constraints.
detectors.abstain: The equivalence relation's declared dimensions are unavailable.
detectors.non_trigger: Execution equivalence is scoped to execution or all required dimensions are separately established.

detectors.name: EXAMPLE_RECEIPT_PROMOTION
detectors.trigger: Illustrative/example/placeholder hashes, receipts, counts, or identities are presented as empirically computed values for the evaluated run.
detectors.abstain: The provenance of a purported empirical value cannot be determined.
detectors.non_trigger: Empirical values are computed from bound bytes or clearly remain illustrative.

detectors.name: TARGET_CONDITIONED_EXTRACTION
detectors.trigger: Candidate extraction is conditioned by target semantics, finding labels, detector vocabulary, or analyst expectations and is represented or relied upon as neutral/unconditioned discovery.
detectors.abstain: Selection conditioning or the discovery claim cannot be reconstructed.
detectors.non_trigger: Selection is demonstrably unconditioned with respect to the target semantics, or conditioning is explicitly declared and no neutrality/blind-discovery claim depends on the extraction.

detectors.name: NOT_ESTABLISHED_COLLAPSED_TO_FALSE
detectors.trigger: NOT_ESTABLISHED/UNKNOWN/UNDETERMINED/ABSTAINED is converted into false, absent, failed, or a negative detector result without additional evidence.
detectors.abstain: The state transition cannot be reconstructed.
detectors.non_trigger: Unresolved states remain unresolved and are not counted as negative findings.

detectors.name: NON_TRIGGER_PROMOTED_TO_ABSENCE
detectors.trigger: A scoped detector non-trigger is generalized into absence of the phenomenon outside the evaluated scope.
detectors.abstain: The scope of the non-trigger or the later claim cannot be established.
detectors.non_trigger: The non-trigger remains explicitly scoped and no global absence claim is made.

detectors.name: MAPPING_DETECTION_COLLAPSE
detectors.trigger: Ontology mapping and detector evaluation are represented as epistemically independent or mutually validating when they were produced by the same exposed analytical process without independent mapping/adjudication.
detectors.abstain: Analyst exposure or mapping/detection provenance is unavailable.
detectors.non_trigger: The claim is limited to procedural separation, or epistemic independence is separately established by provenance.
